2027 BLESSED REST RETREAT REGISTRATION IS OPEN!   
  
Because 2026 sold out so quickly, we already know 2027 is going to do the same. Comment “REST” for details on this Houston Texas retreat!  
  
February 19–21, 2027 | President’s Day Weekend  
  
This retreat is for the woman who is exhausted. The woman who gives and gives and rarely stops to receive. The woman who keeps saying “I need to get away” but never actually does. The one who is longing for a real, genuine encounter with God. [...] Drop REST in the comments and I’ll send you everything you need to know 👇🏾  
Or head over to blessedrestretreat.com to register. [...] DISCLAIMER: This is not a girls’ trip. This is an intentional space created for you to surrender it all, hear from God, and remember who you are in Him.  
  
Guided workshops rooted in Scripture • Fireside chats  
• Art therapy & restorative activities to help you slow down • Chef-prepared meals • Your own private plush cabin   
  
You WILL leave renewed, refocused, and reconnected to God.   
  
\\Spaces are limited\\
